如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    铁柱坐在村内的小路边，望着蔚蓝的天空，神情发呆，铁柱不是他的本名，而是从小因为身体瘦弱，父亲怕养不活，于是按照习俗称呼的小名。
他的本名叫做王林，王姓在四周几个村落内算是大姓，祖上木匠出身，尤其是在县城，王氏家族也算颇有名气，拥有数个专门卖木制品的店铺。
铁柱的父亲是家族内庶出的次子，不能接管家族要务，而是在成婚后离开县城，在此地村庄定居。
由于有一手精湛的木匠活儿，铁柱家境也算小康，吃穿不愁，就算是在村子里，也多受人尊敬。
铁柱从小就极为聪明，喜欢读书，想法很多，几乎是村子内公认的神童，父亲每次听到别人夸奖，脸上的皱纹都会绽开，露出开怀的微笑。
母亲更是对他关心有佳，可以说从小到大，铁柱都是生活在父母的慈爱之中，他知道父母对他期望很高，别人家的孩子在他这个年纪都已经下地干农活了，可他却在家读书。
书读的多了，想法自然也就随之而来，对于山村外的世界，他充满向往。抬头望了望小路的尽头，铁柱叹息一声，合上手中书本，起身向家中走去。
父亲坐在院子里，手中拿着烟袋，深深的吸了一口后，对推门进来的铁柱说道：“铁柱，书读的怎么样了？”
铁柱应付了几句，父亲磕了磕烟袋，起身说道：“铁柱啊，你要好好读书，明年就是县里大考了，你以后有没有出息，可就全看这次了，可别跟我一样，这辈子就呆在村子里，唉。”
“行了，你天天叨叨，要我说，我们家铁柱一定能考上。”铁柱的母亲，端着饭菜放在院内桌子上，招呼他们父子二人过来吃饭。
铁柱哦了一声，坐下后胡乱的拔了几口，母亲慈爱的望着儿子，把不多的几块肉，给他夹过去。
“爹，四叔快来了吧？”铁柱抬头说道。
“算算时间，差不多就是这几天了，你四叔比爹有出息，唉，孩儿他娘，给老四准备的山菜都包好了吧？”父亲一提起老四，脸上露出唏嘘之色。
母亲点头，感慨道：“铁柱啊，你四叔是个好人，这几年幸亏他帮助，你爹做的木雕才能卖出价钱，你以后要是有出息了，别忘记报答你四叔。”
正说着，忽然门外传来马声，接着马车轱辘压地的哗哗声随之而来，一个爽朗的声音在外面响起。
“二哥，开门喽。”
铁柱惊喜，立刻跑过去把院子大门推开，只见一个精壮的中年汉子，目光炯炯的站在门外，他看到铁柱后哈哈一笑，摸了摸他的脑袋，笑道：“铁柱，这才半年没看到，个子又长高了。”
铁柱父母连忙站起，他父亲笑道：“老四，我约莫时间，你也快来了，快进来，铁柱，还不去给你四叔拿凳子去。”
铁柱高兴的应了一声，急忙跑回屋子，拿出一个板凳放在饭桌旁，用袖子认真的擦了擦，希冀的望着中年汉子。
中年汉子冲他眨了眨眼睛，打趣道：“铁柱，这次怎么这么勤快啊，我记得上次我来的时候，你可没这样啊。”

铁柱父亲瞪了铁柱一眼，笑骂道：“这小兔崽子，刚才就在叨叨你是不是快来了。”
中年汉子看到铁柱小脸微红，笑道：“铁柱，你四叔可没忘记答应你的东西。”说完，从怀来拿出两本线状书，放在桌子上。
铁柱兴奋的欢呼一声，拿起书翻看一下，喜不自禁。
铁柱他娘慈祥的望了眼自己儿子，对中年汉子说道：“老四，你哥平时总念叨你，这次多住几天吧。”
中年汉子摇头道：“二嫂，家族这段日子事情多，我明儿一早就要赶回去，等这段时间忙完了，我再来看你们。”说完，他歉意的看了看自己二哥。
铁柱父亲叹息，说道：“老四别听你嫂子的，明儿把货物装好，家族的事儿最重要，咱们以后再聚也一样。”
中年汉子望着铁柱父亲，说道：“二哥，铁柱今年十五岁了吧？”
铁柱父亲点头，感慨道：“过了年，这小兔崽子就十六了，唉，一晃十多年过去，真快。”说着，他眼露溺爱之色，望着自己的儿子。
中年汉子沉吟少许，面色一肃，说道：“二哥，二嫂，和你们说件事儿，恒岳派今年收取弟子，家族有三个推荐名额，分到我这里有一个。”
铁柱父亲一怔，失色道：“恒岳派？可是那个全都是仙人的恒岳派？”

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. Tie Zhu sat on the side of the road in the village, looking at the blue sky, looking dazed. Tie Zhu is not his real name, but the nickname he gave him according to custom because he was thin since he was a child and his father was afraid that he would not be able to support him.
His real name is Wang Lin. The Wang surname is considered a common surname in several surrounding villages. His ancestor was a carpenter. Especially in the county town, the Wang family is quite famous and owns several shops specializing in wood products.
Tiezhu's father was the second son of a concubine in the family and could not take over the family affairs. Instead, he left the county after getting married and settled in the village here.
Because of his skillful carpentry skills, Tiezhu's family was relatively well off, and he had enough food and clothing. Even in the village, he was respected by people.
Tie Zhu has been extremely smart since he was a child. He likes to read and has many ideas. He is almost recognized as a child prodigy in the village. Every time his father hears praise from others, the wrinkles on his face will bloom and he will reveal a cheerful smile.
His mother is even more caring about him. It can be said that Tiezhu has lived in the love of his parents since he was a child. He knows that his parents have high expectations for him. Children of other families are already doing farm work in the fields at his age, but he is studying at home.
After reading more books, ideas naturally followed. He was full of yearning for the world outside the mountain village. Looking up at the end of the path, Tie Zhu sighed, closed the book in his hand, got up and walked home.
His father was sitting in the yard, holding a cigarette bag in his hand. After taking a deep breath, he said to Tie Zhu who pushed the door in and said, "Tie Zhu, how are you doing with your reading?"
Tie Zhu dealt with it for a few words, and his father blew his pipe and stood up and said, "Tie Zhu, you have to study hard. Next year is the county exam. Whether you will be successful in the future depends entirely on this time. Don't be like me and stay in the village for the rest of your life. Alas."
"Okay, you keep nagging every day, if you want me to tell you, our Tie Zhu will definitely pass the exam." Tie Zhu's mother put the food on the table in the courtyard and invited the father and son to come over for dinner.
Tie Zhu groaned, and after sitting down, he took a few bites randomly. The mother looked at her son lovingly, and gave him the few pieces of meat.
"Dad, is fourth uncle coming soon?" Tie Zhu raised his head and said.
"Calculating the time, it's almost been the past few days. Your fourth uncle is more promising than dad. Oh my god, have you wrapped up the mountain vegetables prepared for the fourth child?" When the father mentioned the fourth child, a look of sadness appeared on his face.
The mother nodded and said with emotion: "Tie Zhu, your fourth uncle is a good man. Thanks to his help in the past few years, the wood carvings made by your father can be sold at high prices. If you become successful in the future, don't forget to repay your fourth uncle."
As he was talking, suddenly the sound of horses came from outside the door, followed by the sound of carriages rolling on the ground, and a hearty voice sounded outside.
"Second brother, open the door."
Tie Zhu was pleasantly surprised and immediately ran over and pushed open the courtyard door. He saw a sturdy middle-aged man standing outside the door with piercing eyes. He laughed when he saw Tie Zhu, touched his head and said with a smile: "Tie Zhu, I haven't seen him in half a year, and he has grown taller again."
Tie Zhu's parents stood up quickly, and his father smiled and said: "Fourth brother, I'll make an appointment and you'll be here soon. Come in quickly, Tie Zhu, before you go get your fourth uncle a stool."
Tie Zhu responded happily, hurried back to the house, took out a bench and placed it next to the dining table, wiped it carefully with his sleeve, and looked at the middle-aged man expectantly.
The middle-aged man winked at him and joked: "Tie Zhu, why are you so diligent this time? I remember you were not like this when I came last time."
Tie Zhu's father glared at Tie Zhu and scolded him with a smile: "This little bastard was just talking about whether you are coming soon."
The middle-aged man saw Tie Zhu's face blushing slightly and said with a smile: "Tie Zhu, your fourth uncle did not forget what he promised you." After saying that, he took it from his arms.Take out two linear books and place them on the table.
Tie Zhu cheered excitedly, picked up the book and flipped through it, feeling overjoyed.
Tiezhu's mother looked at her son kindly and said to the middle-aged man: "Fourth brother, your brother always talks about you. Please stay here for a few more days this time."
The middle-aged man shook his head and said: "Second sister-in-law, there are a lot of things going on in the family these days. I have to rush back early tomorrow morning. I will come back to see you when this time is over." After saying that, he looked at his second brother apologetically.
Tiezhu's father sighed and said, "Fourth brother, don't listen to your sister-in-law. Pack the goods tomorrow. Family matters are the most important. It will be the same if we get together in the future."
The middle-aged man looked at Tiezhu's father and said, "Second brother, is Tiezhu fifteen years old this year?"
Tiezhu's father nodded and said with emotion: "After the New Year, this little brat will be sixteen. Alas, more than ten years have passed so quickly." As he said that, he looked at his son with a doting look in his eyes.
The middle-aged man pondered for a while, then looked solemn and said, "Second brother, second sister-in-law, I want to tell you something. The Hengyue Sect is recruiting disciples this year. The family has three recommended places, and I have one assigned to me."
Tie Zhu's father was startled and said with a pale face: "Heng Yue Sect? But that Heng Yue Sect where all the immortals are immortals?"
